text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I bring Winning Ticket to the infirmary
to get her
injury looked at...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aw, man... Looks like I went a teensy bit

overboard...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But it's no problem! This is barely even a
scratch!
And I had it treated properly!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'll focus super hard on healing, so it'll be gone in no time! Let's get back to practice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'll focus super hard on healing, so it'll be gone in no time! Let's get back to practice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No, I swear, I'm totally fine! I get little
injuries all
the time from working out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Y-you're really that worried about
me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That makes me s-so happyyy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Okay, I'll do as you
say.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll get some rest and totally heal up!
Then I can
go full power at training
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket relents and agrees to
give herself
time to recover before
training again.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Woo, that's what I'm talking about!
You're the
best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll dash at full speed back to
the
training track right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRICK!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaagh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, of course! I'm totally... totally...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...not fine at aaaall! This kinda... really...
HURTS!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We end up cutting practice short as I
make sure
Winning Ticket gets all the
rest she needs.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll dash at full speed back to
the
training track right now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! Thanks for worrying about me! If
it hurts
again, I'll tell you right away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But my full power won't lose to any
injury!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you during training! Just watch
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking Winning Ticket's injury in
consideration,
we start training again
after a short break.
